title: Tooltip
description: A short text label shown when the user hovers over or focuses an element. Near the viewport edges it flips and shifts to stay visible.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap a focusable element. The tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it, even when it was opened by hover.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Dark (default), light and semantic color variants.

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: Default, rounded, square and thought-bubble shapes.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose how the tooltip enters and leaves.

custom-colors.title: Colors, arrow and offset
custom-colors.description: bgColor accepts solid colors and CSS gradients; arrow adds a pointer to the trigger; offset sets the gap to the trigger (8px by default).

delays.title: Delays and disabled
delays.description: enterDelay and leaveDelay control the hover timing; disabled turns the tooltip off.

follow-cursor.title: Follow cursor
follow-cursor.description: With followCursor the tooltip tracks the mouse pointer.

controlled.title: Controlled and imperative
controlled.description: Control visibility with open and onOpenChange (hover, focus and Escape still request changes), or call open / close / toggle on a TooltipRef.

events.title: Events
events.description: onOpen and onClose fire on hover, focus, blur and Escape.

TooltipProps.children: The element that triggers the tooltip; prefer a focusable element
TooltipProps.open: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)
TooltipProps.enterDelay: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.leaveDelay: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.offset: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements y is the gap to the trigger and x shifts along it; for left/right placements x is the gap and y shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away
TooltipProps.followCursor: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor
TooltipProps.bgColor: Custom background color (CSS gradients are supported)
TooltipProps.arrow: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger
TooltipProps.className: Additional class name of the trigger wrapper
TooltipProps.onOpen: Called when the tooltip opens from hover or focus
TooltipProps.onClose: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape
TooltipProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label of the tooltip element
TooltipProps.ref: Imperative handle with open / close / toggle
TooltipProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (hover, focus, Escape, ref methods)
